label: Scene Template: Swarm / Chaos Collage
description: WHOLE-SCENE template: the chaos/abundance beat. A cloud of card-props (tweets, stats, quotes, images) is THROWN in with velocity smears, hovers alive, then CONVERGES into one focused headline -- chaos resolving to clarity. Use for 'the old messy way', 'everything you juggle', social-proof walls, or feature-abundance beats -- then cut to a calm scene for maximum density contrast. Dark by default (WebGL ribbon backdrop).

headline.label: The line the chaos resolves into; | breaks lines

kicker.label: Small caps line above the headline

items.label: Array of 8-18 card specs: {kind: text|stat|quote|image, label?, body?, value?, quote?, image?} -- REAL content (real stats, real quotes, brand-kit image URLs), never lorem

backdrop_image.label: On-brand backdrop image URL (replaces the WebGL world)

logo_url.label: Wordmark URL; defaults to the brand-kit wordmark
